source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
From battle round 2, as your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase) begins, you may move one **GREY KNIGHTS** unit of yours from the battlefield into **[Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)** if both apply:

- At the end of the preceding opponent turn, you picked fewer **GREY KNIGHTS** units with [Gate of Infinity](vsdata:ability/grey-knights.gate-of-infinity) than its maximum.
- The unit on the battlefield could have been picked with [Gate of Infinity](vsdata:ability/grey-knights.gate-of-infinity).

The unit keeps its position through your [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), then can be set up somewhere else in that [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase)'s Reinforcements step.

trigger.requires: selected fewer than the Gate of Infinity maximum at end of previous opponent turn

effect.procedure: remove then place in Strategic Reserves
